list.text: The strip would cover every little bump on your tongue, then it pairs with an app, and you pick a flavor.
Now you can eat steamed broccoli, and the cover will block the taste signals, replacing them with your selected flavors, meaning your broccoli will taste like a bacon cheeseburger.
A glass of water tastes like an ice-cold soda, and a sad bowl of boiled chicken tastes like movie theater nachos.
But if you bite your tongue, the cover could glitch, and suddenly every flavor loads at once.

transcript: The strip would cover every little bump on your tongue, then it pairs with an app, and you pick a flavor. Now you can eat steamed broccoli, and the cover will block the taste signals, replacing them with your selected flavors, meaning your broccoli will taste like a bacon cheeseburger. A glass of water tastes like an ice-cold soda, and a sad bowl of boiled chicken tastes like movie theater nachos. But if you bite your tongue, the cover could glitch, and suddenly every flavor loads at once.
